body:
# T16 — Work breakdown structure (retrospective, 2026-11-23)

The six work packages on the frozen scope baseline, with their WSJF integers and acceptance.

## Work packages

| # | Work package | Business value | Time criticality | Risk reduction | Job size | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| 1 | SOP intake as a governed asset: procedures.ingest_sop produces capability and job drafts | 9 | 8 | 6 | 3 | accepted |
| 2 | RDF/OWL/Turtle imported as a strata knowledge pack bound by knowledge_pack_ref | 8 | 7 | 5 | 2 | accepted |
| 3 | BPMN, Visio and draw.io converted into PDDL procedure drafts | 9 | 8 | 6 | 3 | accepted |
| 4 | Source review and human publication gates: the drafting job cannot publish its own procedure | 9 | 7 | 7 | 2 | accepted |
| 5 | Re-ingest versioning keeps the published row's source and pack | 8 | 6 | 6 | 2 | accepted |
| 6 | A bound job runs the PDDL steps; an unreviewed source never binds | 8 | 7 | 6 | 2 | accepted |

## Acceptance

Each package is accepted against executed tests, not prose. The WBS nodes carry their evidence
arrays; each names a test path and the acceptance transcript:

- 1 — `sop_ingestion::a_pdf_sop_becomes_a_pddl_procedure_draft` (`crates/actions/tests/sop_ingestion.rs`)
- 2 — `sop_ingestion::an_owl_file_becomes_a_knowledge_pack`
- 3 — `sop_ingestion::a_bpmn_diagram_becomes_a_procedure_draft`
- 4 — `sop_ingestion::a_human_approval_publishes_the_procedure`, `the_drafting_job_cannot_publish_its_own_procedure`
- 5 — `procedure_versioning::a_reingest_creates_a_new_draft_version`, `the_published_procedure_keeps_its_source_and_pack`
- 6 — `sop_ingestion::a_bound_job_runs_the_pddl_steps`, `an_unreviewed_source_cannot_bind`

The whole set executed 25/25 at the lane head; the transcript is `T16 — Acceptance evidence`.

## Status

All six packages are `accepted` on the scope baseline. The accepted set is what the approved change
`Accept the T16 deliverables with their evidence` records, and what the closure review cites.
